places.name: Sanlúcar de Barrameda
past: The old village of Feningi: farms about a green, with a little church, beside the road.
Raised as a tower keep on the rise above the meeting of the roads; a hamlet gathered beneath its walls. The old village kept its own church, outside the town’s bounds.
Walled, the river and the lie of the land sparing a stretch of the circuit.
A great fire burned 12 houses; it was rebuilt in stone.
The old village of Feningi was at last taken within the walls.

The town outgrew its walls. The new circuit keeps 85% of the old wall and runs out only where the suburbs had spread; a stretch of the old wall inside was pulled down for a street along its line; 1 houses were built into what was left of it.
The walls were rebuilt on the new trace: earthen ramparts faced in stone, angled bastions and a ditch; 34 houses outside were cleared for the glacis.
3 houses were pulled down to make way for the wall.
The old tower keep was rebuilt as a great castle on the same ground.
The parish church was pulled down and rebuilt on its own ground as a great minster.
A great fire burned 17 houses; it was rebuilt in stone.

places.name: Puente Blanca
past: The old village of Aldheim: farms about a green, with a little church, beside the road.
A hamlet grew up at the ford where the road crosses the river; a bridge replaced the ford in its second age. The old village kept its own church, outside the town’s bounds.
The ford was bridged in stone.
4 houses were pulled down to make way for the wall.
Walled, the river and the lie of the land sparing a stretch of the circuit.
A great fire burned 24 houses; it was rebuilt in stone.
A great fire burned 16 houses; it was rebuilt in stone.

places.name: Bonanza
past: An older settlement grew into a town in Roman times. Its main routes survive, with irregular medieval lanes and plots shaped by the ground.
Walled.
The town outgrew its walls. The new circuit keeps 84% of the old wall and runs out only where the suburbs had spread.
The walls were rebuilt on the new trace: earthen ramparts faced in stone, angled bastions and a ditch; 21 houses outside were cleared for the glacis.
A great fire burned 19 houses; it was rebuilt in stone.
